title_en: [Fall Semester 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) Information – Final Poster Presentation Date Changed to 20 November (Fri)
summary: This notice sets out the Fall 2026 schedule, attendance rules and presentation rooms for the Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) course. The final poster presentation has been changed to Friday, 20 November, 09:30–16:30.
applies_to: Students applying for the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) and their laboratories, including project teaching assistants (TAs) for each laboratory and the session-running TAs selected for the 2nd and 3rd presentation sessions.

dates.what: Deadline for project title changes in the intranet system (confirmed by the lab leader and TA)
Session 1: special lecture "Overview of Thesis Writing" (check the day of the week)
Deadline for submission of the final poster file (PDF for the final presentation, A1 size, portrait)
Deadline for writing the draft thesis and having it reviewed by the graduation project supervising professor
Session-running TAs: report of student and TA lateness and absence (paper attendance sheet) to the department office
dates.when: By the morning of the day after each session

steps: Meet with your professor and submit the Interview Confirmation Form (면담확인서) to the staff member at the department office (Building 301, Room 308). You are assigned only after the form is received.
Complete course registration yourself. If either the form or the registration is missing, you cannot take the course.

If you need to change your project title in the intranet system, do so by Friday, 28 August, with confirmation from your lab leader and TA. If the project title or TA changes unavoidably after the semester starts, you must inform the department office. Title changes are not possible after Session 1.
If you drop the course during the semester (for example, because of a leave of absence) after submitting the Interview Confirmation Form, inform the department office.

Attend Session 1, the special lecture "Overview of Thesis Writing", on Friday, 11 September, 18:30–20:30, in Building 301, Room 102 (same room for all modules). Attendance is called at exactly 18:30, so arrive early.
Prepare the Session 2 and Session 3 module presentations together with the laboratory you applied to (about 10 minutes per project).

Attend Session 2 (Thursday, 8 October, 18:30) and Session 3 (Thursday, 5 November, 18:30) in your module's room. Just before presenting, hand your presentation file on a USB drive to the session-running TA.
Submit the final poster file (PDF for the final presentation, A1 size, portrait) by Monday, 9 November, 23:59. The submission method is not stated in the notice.
Write your draft thesis and have it reviewed by your graduation project supervising professor by Monday, 16 November, 23:59.
Attend the final poster presentation for the whole day on Friday, 20 November, 09:30–16:30, in the 1st-floor corridor.
Submit the graduation thesis according to a later announcement.
translation:
[Fall Semester 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) Information – Final Poster Presentation Date Changed to 20 November (Fri)
Posted: 2026-09-22

The basic schedule for the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (course: Electrical Engineering Design Project [전기공학설계프로젝트]) is announced as follows.
Please check the notice emails (sent to the email address you wrote on the Interview Confirmation Form you submitted) and the website notices regularly.
The list for each module has been sent to each student individually by email.

- Students and laboratories applying for the Fall graduation project:
  After meeting with the professor, the Interview Confirmation Form [면담확인서] must be delivered to the staff member in charge (office, Room 308) for assignment to take place, and the student must also complete course registration. (If either is missing, you cannot take the course.)
  If, after submitting the Interview Confirmation Form, you cancel the course during the semester (for example, because of a leave of absence), you must also inform the office.
- Project title changes in the intranet system will be accepted until Friday, 28 August. (Confirmation by the lab leader and TA.)
- If the project title or the TA in charge changes unavoidably after the semester begins, you must inform the staff member in charge at the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
  In particular, if the project title is changed during the semester, both the old and the new titles will appear on the final presentation evaluation sheet.
  This will not affect your grade, but please be aware of it. Project titles cannot be changed after Session 1.

<Students and Project TAs>
※ Attendance at the classes announced below is required. There are no other scheduled sessions.
※ A student who is absent (or late) twice will receive an F, so you must attend. (One absence: grade lowered by one step, e.g. A+ → A0; two absences: F.)
※ Attendance is called at exactly 18:30. Every year some students fail to earn credit because of attendance problems, so please be careful.
※ Lateness cannot be excused unless the reason can be supported by documentation. Some students arrive late because of traffic congestion and then appeal, so please arrive early.
※ Students must prepare the Session 2 and Session 3 module presentations in communication with the laboratory they applied to.
※ Session 2 and Session 3 presentation classes are held in separate classrooms for each module, and each project presents for about 10 minutes.
※ Presenting students must hand their presentation file (USB) to the session-running TA for that session just before presenting.
※ Presenting students must attend Session 4 and all presentation classes. Student project TAs must attend Session 2 and Session 3 presentation classes, at least one per laboratory.
   (TAs do not need to attend the Session 1 class "Overview of Thesis Writing".)
※ If the project title or the TA in charge changes unavoidably after the semester begins, you must inform the staff member in charge at the department office (contact details are in the original notice).

<Session-Running TAs for Sessions 2 and 3>
※ Session-running TAs will be contacted separately and selected.
※ Session-running TAs must arrive at the classroom 15 minutes before the start, finish setting up the laptop and projector, and check attendance at exactly 18:30.
 Please report the lateness and absence of students and TAs to the staff member in charge by the morning of the following day. (Submission of the paper attendance sheet is required / submit to the office, Building 301, Room 308.)

<Time and Schedule> Please check the schedule changes highlighted in yellow. (Note: the yellow highlighting is not visible in the text version and could not be read; the notice title states that the final poster presentation date was changed to 20 November.)

| Project | Date and time |
| Session 1: Special lecture "Overview of Thesis Writing" | Friday, 11 September, 18:30–20:30 ※ Check the day of the week |
| Session 2: Interim presentation | Thursday, 8 October, 18:30 |
| Session 3: Interim presentation | Thursday, 5 November, 18:30 |
| Final poster file submission (PDF for the final presentation, A1 size, portrait) | By Monday, 9 November, 23:59 |
| Writing the draft thesis and having it reviewed (must be reviewed by your graduation project supervising professor) | By Monday, 16 November, 23:59 |
| Final poster presentation | Friday, 20 November, 09:30–16:30 ※ Full-day attendance |
| Graduation thesis submission | To be announced later |
